shortDescription.en: Explore dramatic cliffs, turquoise coves and island life.
shortDescription.id: Jelajahi tebing dramatis, teluk biru, dan kehidupan pulau.

content.en:
Escape to a wild and beautiful island just off Bali’s coast. Spend the day discovering iconic viewpoints, quiet coves and the clear waters of Nusa Penida.

An island made for exploring

Our local team takes care of the details, so you can enjoy the scenery at your own pace.

  • Private island transport
  • Local driver and guide
  • Time to swim and take it all in
content.id:
Jelajahi pulau yang indah di lepas pantai Bali. Nikmati pemandangan ikonis, teluk yang tenang, dan air jernih Nusa Penida.

Pulau untuk dijelajahi

Tim lokal kami mengurus semuanya agar Anda dapat menikmati pemandangan dengan santai.

  • Transportasi privat di pulau
  • Pengemudi dan pemandu lokal
  • Waktu untuk berenang dan bersantai

description.en: Depart from Sanur harbor on a fast boat crossing the sea to Nusa Penida, welcomed directly by your friendly private driver.
description.id: Berangkat dari pelabuhan Sanur menyeberangi selat menuju Nusa Penida dan disambut langsung oleh sopir privat lokal kami.

description.en: Witness the world-famous cliff formation shaped like a dinosaur, towering over powdery white sands and brilliant turquoise waters.
description.id: Menyaksikan tebing ikonis berbentuk T-Rex yang menjulang megah di atas pasir putih dan hamparan air laut biru toska.

title.id: Broken Beach & Kolam Alami Angel's Billabong

description.en: Marvel at a giant circular limestone bridge where ocean waves roll in, and see the natural crystal-clear tidal infinity pool.
description.id: Kagumi jembatan tebing kapur melingkar tempat ombak samudra masuk, serta kolam pasang surut alami dengan air sebening kristal.

description.en: Relax on a tranquil palm-fringed bay, soak in the afternoon island sun, or take a refreshing swim before the return boat trip.
description.id: Bersantai di pantai teduh berderet pohon kelapa, menikmati angin sejuk pulau atau berenang segar sebelum kembali ke Bali.

shortDescription.en: Volcanic views, cool mountain air and a taste of Bali.
shortDescription.id: Pemandangan gunung berapi, udara sejuk, dan cita rasa Bali.

content.en:
Travel into Bali’s green highlands for a refreshing day among volcanic landscapes, ancient temples, and local artisan culture.

The refreshing highlands

Breathe in the cool mountain breeze while taking in majestic panoramic views across Mount Batur and its crater lake.

  • Private air-conditioned car & driver
  • Scenic caldera viewpoint
  • Coffee tasting and temple visits
content.id:
Jelajahi dataran tinggi Bali yang hijau untuk menikmati lanskap vulkanik, pura bersejarah, dan budaya lokal yang kaya.

Kesejukan dataran tinggi

Hirup udara segar pegunungan sambil menikmati pemandangan spektakuler Gunung Batur dan danau kalderanya.

  • Mobil ber-AC privat & sopir berpengalaman
  • Titik pandang kaldera terbaik
  • Mencicipi kopi dan kunjungan pura

description.en: Take in sweeping 180-degree vistas of the majestic active volcano and glistening Lake Batur from the edge of Kintamani ridge.
description.id: Menikmati panorama 180 derajat Gunung Batur yang megah dan kilauan Danau Batur dari ketinggian perbukitan Kintamani.

description.en: Stroll through lush agro-tourism gardens, learn traditional roasting methods, and sample aromatic Balinese coffees and spiced teas.
description.id: Menyusuri kebun agrowisata yang asri, melihat proses sangrai tradisional, dan mencicipi aneka kopi serta teh rempah khas Bali.

title.en: Tirta Empul Holy Water Spring Temple
title.id: Pura Tirta Empul & Mata Air Suci

description.en: Discover a sacred 10th-century water temple fed by natural bubbling mountain springs, famous for its serene spiritual cleansing pools.
description.id: Mengunjungi pura bersejarah abad ke-10 dengan mata air alami pegunungan yang jernih, terkenal dengan kolam penyucian spiritualnya.

shortDescription.en: Experience the serene side of Bali among temples and rice fields.
shortDescription.id: Nikmati sisi tenang Bali di antara pura dan sawah.

content.en:
Discover Ubud’s rich artistic heritage, emerald rice terraces, and tranquil spiritual hideaways with a knowledgeable local guide.

The cultural heart of Bali

Ubud blends peaceful natural scenery with inspiring art galleries, royal architecture, and sacred forests.

  • Private hotel pickup and drop-off
  • Personal local driver & guide
  • Flexible stops and photography time
content.id:
Jelajahi kekayaan seni Ubud, hamparan sawah bertingkat, dan tempat peristirahatan spiritual bersama pemandu lokal.

Jantung budaya Bali

Ubud memadukan ketenangan alam pedesaan dengan galeri seni, arsitektur istana, dan hutan suci yang teduh.

  • Penjemputan dan pengantaran privat di hotel
  • Sopir & pemandu lokal berpengalaman
  • Waktu kunjungan santai dan fleksibel

description.en: Walk under ancient banyan trees among sacred temple ruins and encounter friendly Balinese long-tailed monkeys in their natural habitat.
description.id: Menyusuri jalan setapak di bawah pohon beringin kuno, candi bersejarah, dan berinteraksi dengan monyet ekor panjang yang ramah.

description.en: Admire the iconic sculpted green hillside paddies built with the ancient Subak irrigation system, surrounded by coconut palms.
description.id: Mengagumi keindahan undakan sawah hijau menakjubkan dengan sistem irigasi tradisional Subak yang diakui dunia.

title.en: Ubud Royal Palace & Traditional Art Market
title.id: Puri Saren Agung & Pasar Seni Ubud

description.en: Step into historical royal courtyards and browse vibrant market stalls filled with handmade silk scarves, woodcarvings, and handicrafts.
description.id: Melihat kemegahan istana kerajaan Ubud dan berburu suvenir kerajinan tangan, tenun sutra, serta ukiran kayu khas seniman lokal.

shortDescription.en: Take the scenic route through jungle trails and village lanes.
shortDescription.id: Susuri jalur hutan dan jalan desa yang indah.

content.en:
Ride through Bali’s backroads on a guided ATV quad bike adventure through bamboo forests, muddy trails, river streams, and dark tunnels.

Off-road excitement

Designed for both beginners and experienced riders, with professional instructors and full safety gear provided.

  • All-terrain quad bike (single or tandem)
  • Safety gear: helmet and gumboots
  • Shower facilities and Indonesian lunch
content.id:
Kendarai quad bike ATV menembus jalur tersembunyi Bali melintasi hutan bambu, lintasan lumpur, aliran sungai, dan terowongan gua.

Keseruan off-road

Cocok untuk pemula maupun yang berpengalaman, lengkap dengan instruktur profesional dan perlengkapan keamanan berstandar internasional.

  • Unit quad bike bertenaga (single atau tandem)
  • Perlengkapan aman: helm & sepatu boots
  • Fasilitas shower dan makan siang prasmanan

description.en: Meet your instructor, get fitted with safety helmets and boots, and complete a brief test-track trial to get familiar with controls.
description.id: Bertemu instruktur berpengalaman, memakai helm serta sepatu pelindung, dan latihan singkat mengemudikan ATV di arena latihan.

title.en: Jungle Trails, Mud Tracks & Rice Fields

description.en: Conquer adrenaline-pumping dirt trails, deep mud splash zones, quiet bamboo groves, and open village rice paddy landscapes.
description.id: Menaklukkan rute off-road seru penuh kubangan lumpur menantang, rimbunnya hutan bambu, dan jalan pedesaan yang asri.

title.en: Cave Tunnel Ride & River Rapids Crossing

description.en: Ride right through a dark carved rock tunnel and splash through rocky shallow river beds before returning for hot showers and lunch.
description.id: Menerobos terowongan gua batu yang spektakuler dan membelah aliran air sungai berbatu sebelum mandi hangat dan makan siang.

shortDescription.en: Paddle through lush river valleys and tropical scenery.
shortDescription.id: Mengarungi lembah hijau dan pemandangan tropis.

content.en:
Share a memorable white-water river journey down the pristine Ayung River valley with expert river guides and breathtaking rainforest views.

Adrenaline in nature

Tackle exciting Class II & III rapids past secret waterfalls, dramatic stone cliffs, and dense tropical foliage.

  • 12 km scenic river rafting course
  • Certified professional river guide in every boat
  • Complete safety gear, shower and buffet lunch
content.id:
Nikmati petualangan arung jeram seru menyusuri Sungai Ayung yang asri bersama instruktur profesional dan panorama lembah tropis.

Sensasi alam yang memukau

Taklukkan jeram tingkat II & III melewati air terjun tersembunyi, tebing berukir relief Ramayana, dan pepohonan hijau nan rimbun.

  • Jalur arung jeram sepanjang 12 km
  • Pemandu berlisensi di setiap perahu karet
  • Peralatan lengkap, ruang bilas hangat & makan siang

description.en: Put on life jackets and lightweight helmets, receive paddle instructions, and descend into the spectacular Ayung river valley.
description.id: Mengenakan pelampung dan helm keselamatan, mendapat panduan mendayung dari instruktur, dan turun menuju bibir lembah Sungai Ayung.

title.id: 12 KM Jeram Sungai & Air Terjun Alami

description.en: Navigate thrilling rapids, stop by a cascading natural waterfall for photos, and admire ancient carved cliff reliefs along the route.
description.id: Mengarungi jeram seru selama kurang lebih 2 jam, berfoto di air terjun alami, dan menikmati relief pahatan artistik di tebing sungai.

title.en: Hot Showers & Buffet Lunch with Valley View
title.id: Bilas Hangat & Makan Siang Pemandangan Ngarai

description.en: Freshen up in clean modern shower facilities, then savor a generous buffet spread of local Balinese dishes overlooking the valley.
description.id: Membersihkan diri di ruang shower yang nyaman, lalu menikmati hidangan prasmanan lezat sambil menikmati suasana lembah yang tenang.

shortDescription.en: Four days to discover the island’s varied landscapes and culture.
shortDescription.id: Empat hari menjelajahi lanskap dan budaya Bali.

content.en:
A considered multi-day journey from lively southern coastlines to cool northern highlands and sacred temple valleys.

The complete Bali experience

Leave every detail to our dedicated team so you can immerse yourself in the culture, flavors, and wonders of the Island of the Gods.

  • 4 days / 3 nights fully private curated itinerary
  • Dedicated private vehicle and personal driver throughout
  • Includes airport pickup, all entrance fees, and boat tickets
content.id:
Perjalanan beberapa hari menjelajahi pesisir selatan yang memikat hingga dataran tinggi utara yang sejuk dan pura bersejarah.

Pengalaman terlengkap di Bali

Serahkan seluruh perencanaan kepada tim kami agar Anda dapat menikmati keindahan alam, budaya, dan kuliner Pulau Dewata dengan nyaman.

  • Paket lengkap 4 hari / 3 malam privat terkurasi
  • Kendaraan privat & sopir berdedikasi sepanjang perjalanan
  • Termasuk penjemputan bandara, tiket masuk wisata, dan fast boat

title.en: Day 1: Airport Welcome & Uluwatu Sunset Temple
title.id: Hari 1: Penjemputan Bandara & Sunset Tebing Uluwatu

description.en: Warm VIP airport greeting, hotel check-in, and an unforgettable afternoon at Uluwatu Cliff Temple overlooking the Indian Ocean.
description.id: Penyambutan privat di bandara, check-in hotel, dilanjutkan kunjungan ke Pura Uluwatu di atas tebing megah menghadap Samudra Hindia.

title.id: Hari 2: Pesona Budaya Ubud & Terasering Tegalalang

description.en: Explore Sacred Monkey Forest, iconic green terraced rice fields, holy springs at Tirta Empul, and Ubud art handicraft markets.
description.id: Menjelajahi Monkey Forest, hamparan sawah bertingkat Tegalalang, mata air suci Tirta Empul, dan galeri seni kerajinan Ubud.

title.en: Day 3: Nusa Penida Island Hop Adventure
title.id: Hari 3: Petualangan Menyeberang ke Nusa Penida

description.en: Full day island excursion by speed boat exploring Kelingking Beach, Broken Beach, and Angel's Billabong crystal tide pools.
description.id: Eksplorasi seharian penuh naik fast boat ke Nusa Penida mengunjungi tebing Pantai Kelingking, Broken Beach, dan Angel's Billabong.

title.en: Day 4: Coffee Tasting, Souvenirs & Airport Farewell
title.id: Hari 4: Mencicipi Kopi, Belanja Oleh-oleh & Pengantaran

description.en: Relaxed morning visit to local specialty coffee roasters and artisan souvenir stores, followed by private airport transfer for departure.
description.id: Pagi santai mencicipi kopi Bali dan berbelanja oleh-oleh khas, diakhiri dengan pengantaran nyaman ke bandara untuk penerbangan pulang.
